title: Plantasia: Nature's Call
description: Embrace the call of Nature in new world generation!
body:
Welcome to Plantasia: Call of Nature!
**


This is a mod that'sm meant to be a faithful remake of the old Natura mod from 1.12.2, It has no association with mDiyo and their dev team. It's purely a standalone venture. **

This mod adds a plethora of nature themed items,  building blocks, biomes, and world generation features.

Over 10 new trees, saplings, and wood types to discover and build with

New flowers and vegetation to find

New blocks to find throughout the world.

Clouds filling the empty sky of your Minecraft world!



More content is likely to come soon.



Credits

mDiyo and their team for creating the original mod. A majority of concepts and ideas come from Natura 1.12.2. A majority of assets come from Tomanex and the Elite Modding Team, I am using their assets given permission from Tomanex himself.

 if you're an original author and wish for the mod to be taken down, dm me on discord at phwee and I'll take care of your request.
